column1: # The checks of shell/authA7.nsh, the boot of shell-authA7: MyIfrNVData has the attributes
# get shows why it does not decode it: with 0x80, GetVariable() data starts with metadata
# (UEFI 2.10 §8.2.1); this firmware returns the seeded bytes as they are, so the attribute alone

column3: .responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("<ValueUnavailable: EFI variable MyIfrNVData-a04a27f4-df00-4d42-b552-39511302113d has enhanced authenticated access (attributes 0xa7)"))

column1: # set refuses to write it, with or without --bypass-setup-password, before SetVariable()

column3: . == {"error_message": "EFI variable MyIfrNVData-a04a27f4-df00-4d42-b552-39511302113d has authenticated access (attributes 0xa7), which uefisettings does not write"}
. == {"error_message": "EFI variable MyIfrNVData-a04a27f4-df00-4d42-b552-39511302113d has authenticated access (attributes 0xa7), which uefisettings does not write"}
. == {"error_message": "EFI variable MyIfrNVData-a04a27f4-df00-4d42-b552-39511302113d has authenticated access (attributes 0xa7), which uefisettings does not write"}

column1: # and the variable stays as it was
